title: Case 029: Cracked basin repair request
initial_request:
Hello, 
I would like my sink from the batroom fixt .
overview: The tenant reported a cracked hand basin and said it had been like that when they moved in. Northbridge Lettings assigned maintenance provider Henry Quinn, who was asked to arrange access and initially asked how the basin became cracked. The request was held while awaiting a tenant response, an appointment, and internal updates. An internal note later recorded that Miles advised the job was done; no quote was required. The record says landlord confirmation and key-return checks were needed before closure. The request was closed after checks were completed.
outcome: The request was closed after all checks were completed. An internal note recorded that Miles advised the basin repair was done; the referenced completion document was not uploaded.
